dogecoin.text: @Lagaless Its simple..Market cap = Total Circulating Supply * Price of each coin.  lets say dogecoin has 200,000 coins circulating on the market with each one worth 3$, the market cap of the crypto would be 200, 000*3=$600,000. so i used the statistics of the apparent total supply of doge

@Lagaless It will NEVER. For each dollar increase in Dogecoin price, the market cap would need to rise $180 billion. So, for $1000 per Dogecoin, the total market cap of Doge would be more than $180 trillion, two times that of the world’s economy. It’s absurd. Never going to happen.
